meta.name: support_triage
meta.title: Support ticket triage
meta.description: Dev set for harness tuning: new emails in the same style as the golden support_triage set.

intent.instructions: What does the customer want in `message`?

criteria.refund: money returned or a duplicate charge reversed
criteria.technical_help: a bug, outage or integration problem
criteria.billing_question: a question about an invoice, plan or payment method
criteria.other: none of the other options fits

is_urgent.instructions: Does `message` communicate time pressure or a deadline?

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the customer sound in `message`?
criteria: very angry or using strong language

refund_requested.instructions: Does the customer ask for money back?

churn_risk.instructions: Does `message` suggest the customer may leave for a competitor or cancel?

impact_scope.instructions: How many people does the issue in `message` affect?
criteria: the whole company or its customers

tags.synthetic: Generated from phrase banks, so labels are correct by construction
tags.low_stakes: Intent is information or other: never urgent, no refund or churn phrases

input.message: Good morning, My card was billed $49 for an add-on I never ordered. Nobody else is affected, it's just me. Please send that $49 back to my card. I'm a little worried about this, though I'm sure it was an honest slip-up. Cheers,

rationale: Intent refund: asks for money back for a wrong or duplicate charge; impact is only the sender; tone is concerned but civil; no deadline; asks for money back; no churn signal.
